text:
kelly: quick thread for Polaris RFI/POC — buyer asked for an air-gapped eval option plus a hosted trial. Need SE + ProdSec + Legal checks before we hand over docs tomorrow. Attached: polaris_rfi_draft.pdf, polaris_capmatrix.csv

rohan: reading. two immediate asks from buyer: 1) can we do a one-week air-gapped POC on their subnet? 2) they want cost estimates for 3 traffic patterns (low/med/peak).

maya: For air-gapped: yes via our Private package. Important notes: on-prem installer needs a connectivity window to pull image hashes (or provide offline bundle). Timeline +2 weeks if they require HSM. I'll add a short runbook.

dawn-legal: I'll review the liability and IP clauses for the air-gapped scenario. Also we should include a DPA and clarify data ingress/egress responsibilities. Will upload redlines.

prodsec-bot: Security checklist: missing: attestations for image signing, key escrow policy, and logging retention controls. Also request SCA results for the build. Fill Q18-Q24 in the security sheet.

kelly: noted. I'll add an explicit line: "customer provides installation media; Redwood does not copy or store PII during install" and a step for signature verification.

rohan: pricing: I'll prepare a conservative and best-case cost table for low/med/peak and include embedding unit assumptions. Will attach `polaris_poc_costs.csv`.

maya: POC plan suggestion: 2d install/verify, 5d steady-state, 2d peak tests. Include perf harness and synthetic dataset. Add curl example for smoke test:
```
curl -X POST https://private.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-1b","input":"clinical test note"}'
```

dawn-legal: uploaded polaris_rfi_legal_redlines.docx. Main asks: indemnity carveouts for customer-provided data and clarifying POC acceptance criteria.

files-bot: uploaded polaris_rfi_draft.pdf (1.3MB), polaris_capmatrix.csv (22KB), polaris_poc_costs.csv (6KB), polaris_runbook.md (2KB)

kelly: ProdSec and Legal sign-off needed. Maya — can you update the runbook with offline bundle steps? Dawn — please confirm redlines by 10:30 PT.

maya: updated runbook with offline bundle steps and signature verification. SE sign-off done.

dawn-legal: green on redlines, small tweak to POC acceptance language. Done.

kelly: perfect. I'll send to Polaris ops now and request preferred window. Thanks all :rocket:
